old_description: In 2020, nanotron was acquired by Inpixon. Recognized as an industry leader in the ultra-wideband (UWB) market, nanotron’s precision location awareness technology solutions enhance Inpixon’s offering and homogenize the positioning of people and assets, both indoors and outdoors. Together, nanotron’s solutions and Inpixon’s indoor data technology, sensors, video surveillance solutions, and GPS offerings, combine to deliver actionable indoor location data and intelligence. Nanotron is a leading provider of electronic location awareness solutions. If knowing what, where and when is mission-critical to your business, rely on nanotron with Location Running.
about:
TOP-electronics USA operates from Tucson, Arizona, as the American arm of a global distribution business founded in 2005 by Arco Snoey in the Netherlands. The company began with a focus on connecting engineers with electronic components and technical expertise, growing into a knowledge-driven distributor with offices across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia.

The firm distributes electronic components and modules from a portfolio that spans wireless and IoT, test and measurement, motion control, precision analog, power conversion, displays and embedded computing, sensors, connectors and cables, and thermal management. Beyond fulfillment, it provides design-in support, component selection, lifecycle and end-of-life management, alternative sourcing, buffer stock programs, and logistics solutions, all backed by an ISO 9001:2015 quality system and ESD-protected handling.

Customers include OEMs, R&D teams, and engineers in sectors such as industrial automation, medical devices, and aerospace, though the company does not publicly list specific end markets. Its specialists work with purchasers and technical decision-makers from prototype through scalable production, helping navigate supply-chain risks and component obsolescence.

Snoey started the business on the belief that strong technical partnerships create better products, a philosophy that still drives the emphasis on personal contact and long-term continuity over transactional volume.

name: TROCOFAB
old_description: At TROCOFAB, we do quality work. We specialize in metal manufacturing and metal fabrication. We collaborate
about:
TROCOFAB, a metal manufacturer and fabricator, was founded in 2002 by Tim Trotter in St. Louis, Missouri. Trotter, a U.S. Army veteran who previously ran a family-owned manufacturing business, began by building custom metal furniture before expanding into architectural and structural metalwork. The company’s first shop occupied 5,000 square feet downtown; it moved to a larger facility in 2007 and doubled that space in 2010, now operating from the Hill neighborhood.

The firm provides a full range of metal fabrication and manufacturing services, including water‑jet and laser cutting, MIG and TIG welding, machining, brake forming, rolling, drilling, grinding, polishing, and finishing. It also offers project management, design assistance, value engineering, 3D/2D CAD drawing, prototype building, and installation. The shop handles single‑part prototypes through multipart production runs and produces architectural features such as monumental stairs, handrail systems, canopies, awnings, and building facades.

TROCOFAB serves general contractors, subcontractors, architects, and creatives across the restaurant, hospitality, healthcare, and construction sectors. Notable projects include the Edward Jones parking garage in Maryland Heights, the Museum at the Gateway Arch in St. Louis, a coffee house in Miami Beach, and a sculpture installation at Discovery Green Park in Houston. The company is also an authorized Ultralox Interlocking® dealer.

The company emphasizes detailed planning — “detailed drawings get detailed results” — and value engineering to preserve design intent while reducing costs. Its central Midwest location enables economical shipping to major cities such as Chicago, Dallas, and Atlanta, and its full‑service subcontractor model includes on‑site installation when needed.

name: TX Metal Solutions
old_description: TX Metal Solutions is your best choice for all types of welding, fabrication and construction services, providing quality craftsmanship and affordable pricing to residential and commercial customers across the region.
about:
TX Metal Solutions operates from Laguna Park, Texas, on the shores of Lake Whitney in Bosque County, with a second shop in China Spring. The business is run by Tim, who handles inquiries directly, though the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides mobile welding and custom metal fabrication across twelve defined service categories, including custom patio covers, carports, RV covers, boat dock and boathouse repair on Lake Whitney, custom trailers and trailer repair, equipment repair for farms and ranches, ADA and commercial handrails, metal buildings and structural frames, custom fabrication with plasma cutting, mezzanines and lofts, custom metal tables, and stainless steel and aluminum fabrication. They work four metals — mild steel, carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum — applying the appropriate process for each.

Customers are residential and commercial clients across Bosque, Hill, and McLennan counties. Concrete examples include welded dock repairs on a Corps of Engineers lake, custom trailers built to spec, structural steel for shops and barns, code-compliant handrails for public buildings, and corrosion-resistant aluminum fabrication for marine and outdoor use.

The company distinguishes itself by focusing exclusively on welding and fabrication — it is not a general contractor, home builder, or remodeler. It brings welding equipment to the customer’s site, publishes honest drive times for its service area, and limits its offerings to twelve listed services so clients know exactly what is in scope.

name: Tak Communications
old_description: TAK Broadband is a leading end-to-end U.S. fiber and broadband network contractor, offering comprehensive service solutions, from construction to drops to fulfillment, to door-to-door marketing & sales.
about:
TAK Broadband, LLC was founded in 2004 in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, initially as a door-to-door fulfillment contractor for broadband operators. The company operates as a limited liability company and has since expanded into a national fiber broadband network construction contractor.

Today the firm provides end-to-end outside plant construction, last-mile drop installation, on-premises fulfillment, and door-to-door marketing and sales for broadband networks. It maintains a workforce of more than 1,000 technicians supported by over 200 qualified construction crews and 400 bury drop crews across 139 offices in 42 states.

Its customers include internet service providers, multiple system operators, telecommunications carriers, electric cooperatives, tribal communities, municipalities, and private equity firms. The company also specializes in federally funded grant programs such as USDA RUS, ARPA, CPF, RDOF, ACAM, TBCP, and BEAD, offering grant writing assistance and compliance reporting.

TAK Broadband emphasizes a safety-first culture that meets OSHA, DOT, and EPA standards, and it differentiates itself through a full ecosystem that covers grant management, supply chain, engineering, construction, drops, fulfillment, project management, and marketing under one roof.

name: Tallapoosa River Electric
old_description: To pay your bill, apply for new service, or request a transfer/disconnection
about:
Tallapoosa River Electric Cooperative (TREC) was established in 1939 and is headquartered in LaFayette, Alabama. The cooperative operates as a not-for-profit, member-owned utility governed by a democratically elected board of trustees. It serves members across Clay, Randolph, Tallapoosa, Chambers, Lee, Russell, and Barbour counties in east-central Alabama.

TREC distributes electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial members throughout its seven-county service territory. Beyond power delivery, the cooperative provides free energy audits, free residential power quality audits, and free HVAC design assistance. It maintains multiple office locations in LaFayette, Fort Mitchell, Smith Station, Mellow Valley, and New Site, along with authorized payment drop boxes at Auburn Bank branches.

The cooperative’s members include homeowners, farmers, small businesses, and industrial facilities within its service area. TREC also supports community initiatives such as the Rural Electric Cooperative Youth Tour, which offers high school juniors scholarships and trips to Montgomery and Washington, D.C.

TREC emphasizes its not-for-profit structure and member ownership as key differentiators, with a stated motto of “providing reliable consumer service.” The organization cites commitments to integrity, innovation, accountability, community service, and fairness as guiding values.

name: Tampa Sheet Metal Co
old_description: Tampa Sheet Metal Company was Founded in 1920 by John Jiretz, Senior. John was a skilled craftsman who had learned his trade in Austria and Germany. The sheet metal fabrication business has progressed from the early days of using hand tools into a modern facility of sheet metal manufacturing equipment including: a laser running at the speed of light, robotic arc welding.
about:
Tampa Sheet Metal Company was founded in 1920 by John Jiretz Sr., a craftsman who learned his trade in Austria and Germany. The company is located in Tampa, Florida, and remains family-owned, currently managed by John L. Jiretz (president, grandson of the founder) and John D. Jiretz (great-grandson). It began as a sheet metal fabrication business using hand tools and has evolved into a modern facility.

The company provides full-service sheet metal fabrication from design to finished product. Processes include laser cutting (4,000-watt laser cutting stainless steel, steel, aluminum, brass, copper on a 60x120-inch table), CNC turret punching (36-station, 45-ton press), press braking (12-foot and 6-foot capacity), metal shearing (12-foot, quarter-inch thick steel), robotic welding (steel, aluminum, stainless steel), hardware insertion, countersinking, counterboring, and mechanical assembly. The facility spans 25,000 square feet near downtown Tampa.

Tampa Sheet Metal serves industrial, commercial, and construction sectors. Project examples from the company's archive include industrial facilities, shopping malls, high-rise buildings, EPC projects, infrastructure, and commercial buildings.

The company emphasizes its long-standing dedication to quality and service since 1920, with a quality control program certified by FM Approvals and Keystone Certifications. It also highlights environmental responsibility, noting that sheet metal is 100% recyclable and all scrap is melted down for reuse.

name: Tangent Cable Systems Inc
old_description: Tangent Cable Systems ® has developed a business plan which provides our clients with a unique integration of services for the installation of electrical, network infrastructure and security systems cabling.
about:
Tangent Cable Systems Inc operates from Wilmington, Delaware. The company's founding year is not publicly disclosed, and ownership details are not specified. It was established to deliver an integrated service offering for the installation of electrical, network infrastructure, and security systems cabling.

The firm provides commercial cabling and wiring services through IBEW-trained electrical craftsmen. Its scope covers electrical design and project management, ongoing maintenance, structured network cabling installation, and security system deployment including card access, CCTV, control cabinet wiring, conduit raceway, and intercom systems. The company also handles sign and pole light service. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Tangent serves financial institutions, military installations, the Delaware gaming industry, communications companies, and general service-industry clients. It collaborates with architects, designers, IT professionals, facility managers, construction managers, and security engineers to ensure compliant, adequate cabling infrastructure.

The company emphasizes its Delaware State Alarm license, which requires FBI background checks on core employees, providing a vetted workforce for sensitive environments. Clients cite commitment, workmanship, and turnaround time as distinguishing factors, with long-term relationships spanning over a decade.

Tankersley Food Services operates from Van Buren, Arkansas, as a family-owned business that traces its roots back more than 80 years. The company emphasizes its independent ownership as a contrast to larger corporate competitors, though the exact founding year and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

Its operation stocks more than 10,000 SKUs and uses supply-chain technology to maintain high fill rates and order accuracy across its delivery network.

Tankersley serves foodservice operators — restaurants, institutional kitchens, and similar buyers — throughout its region. The company hosts an annual food show that brings together suppliers and customers for product discovery and pricing programs, and it markets a private-label coffee line called Chaffee Grinds.

Leadership frames the business around a “whatever it takes” service philosophy and a commitment to community giving, supporting organizations such as the Community Services Clearinghouse, Ronald McDonald House Charities, and the Ben Geren Youth Golf Academy. That local focus, paired with operational scale, is presented as the core differentiator.

name: Tarrier Foods Corporation
old_description: However, Ann quickly realized she had bigger ambitions and decided to take control of her own destiny. With determination and a trusted partner by her side, she stepped out and founded her own business - focused on mixing nuts and dried fruits.
about:
Tarrier Foods Corporation operates from Columbus, Ohio, as a family-owned food processor founded by Ann, who left a previous role to start her own business blending nuts and dried fruits. The company does not disclose a founding year, but describes decades of expertise in the ingredient space.

The company processes, blends, and packages sweet and savory inclusions and toppings for branded, private-label, and retail products. Its capabilities include simultaneous multi-item blending, size reduction, roasting, seasoning, and a range of packaging formats such as portion-control pouches, stand-up pouches, pillow pouches, bulk bag-in-box, bowls, and shakers. Tarrier also maintains a stocked inventory of branded inclusions—including OREO®, Chips Ahoy!®, Nutter Butter®, and Sour Patch Kids® Bitz—available for immediate shipment through distributor Dot Foods.

Tarrier serves food manufacturers, quick-service restaurant chains, distributors, and private-label brands across the United States and Canada. Its ingredients appear in desserts, baked goods, salads, and sandwiches. Long-term customers cite relationships spanning 11 to 20 years, highlighting the company’s role as an innovation partner for product development.

Tarrier emphasizes speed to market, custom formulation flexibility, and rigorous food safety controls as its differentiators. The founder’s original vision—to control her own destiny by creating unique ingredient blends—remains central to the company’s pitch: helping brands move faster from concept to production with tailored ingredient solutions.

name: Taste New Mexico
old_description: Sharing the finest, hand-crafted artisan food products grown and produced in the Land of Enchantment since 2002.
about:
Taste New Mexico operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it was founded in 2002 as an online marketplace for artisan foods produced in the state. The company maintains a retail shop at 1301 Cuesto Abajo Ct NE and ships nationwide.

The business curates and sells a range of shelf-stable products from New Mexican brands such as Santa Fe Seasons, Rio Grande Roasters, and Santa Fe Gourmet. Offerings include Hatch chile salsas and sauces, piñon coffee, biscochitos, popcorn, soup mixes, and gift bundles. The company describes itself as a distributor of these products worldwide, fulfilling orders through its e-commerce site and physical location.

Customers include retail consumers seeking authentic New Mexican flavors, as well as wholesale buyers looking for certified Hatch chile and NM True Certified products. The company serves the specialty food and gourmet gift markets across the continental United States, with free shipping on orders over $100.

Taste New Mexico emphasizes its NM True Certified and Certified Hatch Chile Food Vendor designations as marks of authenticity. It promotes family recipes passed down through generations and guarantees that all products are traditionally made in New Mexico.
